disclaimer: DESCRIPTIVE -- CONSUMED DEVELOPMENT DATA -- NOT VALIDATION EVIDENCE
method: Each of the 1,093 frozen resolved setups may carry zero or more descriptive category tags. Thresholds (stop_distance_atr <= Q1, initial_rr <= Q1, atr_at_entry <= Q1 / >= Q3, losing-streak length >= 5) are the full-dataset quartiles of already-frozen, decision-time-observable fields -- fixed once here, never swept or chosen to maximize any category's apparent effect. 'observable_at_decision_time' is false for categories that are inherently retrospective (e.g. TARGET_NOT_REACHED_DESPITE_POSITIVE_MFE requires knowing MFE, which only exists after entry) -- those categories explain what happened but must never be used directly as a pre-entry gate condition.

STOP_BEFORE_CONFIRMATION.not_assignable_reason: Every emitted setup already required a completed M5 structure-break confirmation before TRADE_READY by construction (analysis/volatility_structure_pullback_engine.py) -- this category cannot occur in this engine's output and is reported as zero by definition, not estimated.

LATE_ENTRY.not_assignable_reason: No entry-timing/chase-distance field was persisted per setup in the frozen dataset (decision_time already equals fill time for every row -- see Part 4 finding).

CHASED_ENTRY.not_assignable_reason: The engine's own chase_valid gate excludes chased entries before a setup is ever emitted as TRADE_READY -- no chased setup exists in this dataset to count.

EXCESSIVE_SETUP_AGE.not_assignable_reason: Setup age was not persisted per setup in the frozen dataset.

POOR_RANGE_LOCATION.not_assignable_reason: M15 dealing-range position at entry was not persisted per setup in the frozen dataset (the engine's internal range_position gate result was not written to resolved_setups.csv).

EXCESSIVE_ZONE_WIDTH.not_assignable_reason: M15 pullback-zone width was not persisted per setup in the frozen dataset.

NO_CLEAR_MECHANISM.note: By construction, every net-negative setup is already tagged DIRECTIONAL_FAILURE (negative gross_r -- the underlying directional bet itself lost) or COST_ERASED_SMALL_EDGE (positive-but-small gross_r that the flat 0.10R cost erased), so no loss in this dataset is left mechanism-free. This category exists for completeness against the suggested list and is reported as zero rather than omitted.

FOLD_CONCENTRATION.note: Aggregate-level, not a per-setup category -- see data/stabilization/phase7/postmortem/failure_decomposition.json -> D_stability.fold_contribution_concentration (top_fold_profit_share, top_month_profit_share).
